$comment: Copy to src/evidence/<TICKET>/test-cases.json and draft from the ticket's acceptance criteria before writing any spec. Nothing goes to test management until every automated case has a passing spec: `test` is its exact Playwright test title, and `publish.mjs cases` refuses a case whose title is missing or not in the run's results, unless it has "manual": true. `mark-pass` then records the run against the created cases. Steps are user actions a manual tester can follow: no selectors, no file paths. The expected result is one observable outcome.

cases.name: Verify a cart can be checked out to a confirmation
cases.precondition: Signed in as the automation user with an empty cart.
steps: Add the Sauce Labs Backpack to the cart
Open the cart and select Checkout
Enter a first name, last name and postal code, then select Continue
cases.expected: The confirmation page reads "Thank you for your order!"
cases.test: a cart can be checked out to a confirmation

cases.name: Verify checkout refuses to continue without the shopper's details
cases.precondition: Signed in, with one product in the cart.
steps: Open the cart and select Checkout
Leave every field empty and select Continue
cases.expected: An error reads "First Name is required" and the overview page does not open
